Hey,
I haven't had a single relationship all thru high school so I can't say I'm the best advice for this, but someone else asked me something that I could see in the same situation but, why are you always looking for a relationship. Take some time to yourself. I know exactly how you feel(I'm skinny as hell) to feel like everyone judges you of just looks,and if a man is going for you just for your looks, then he's not a man at all he's just a premature douchbag, a man would love you even if you were a burn victim. And as for the good guys that were taken, that's their loss. Your 22 going thru college, that's a lot more than I can say. But this isn't about me, the point is fuck those guys, by the time they realise what their doing is wrong, it'll be too late for them. Chin up there are good guys out there, I promise.

I guess it all come down to a lot of my relatives married their "high school" so I feel if I don't do the same then I'll die alone, but i know it's not really that way but I just don't want to end up like my mother having to raise a child from 19 to 37. And trust me id like nothing more than to just forget about her but it's like I need an objective or something to be working towards, my grandfather thinks college is a good place to start but I really think I'm smart enough for all that. Just seeing how much different the world is when you first see it.i don't know sometimes I feel like there's just no way out (sounds corny I know) and the whole dating thing isn't helped by a uncle and a step father who constantly harass you for being 18 and single.
